prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. This is the ONE consolidated corrective redraw of a medieval RPG dialogue portrait.
Inputs: image 1 is the edit target, supplying this man's identity and clothes. Images 2-5 are exact enlarged 74x100 pixel portraits Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, supplying the REQUIRED coarse cluster size, angular facial planes and minimal neck/collar framing. Copy their low-resolution economy, not their identities.
Make a substantially coarser and tighter FACE portrait than image 1: large clean connected skin, hair and beard masses, no small texture stripes. Think of a 74x100 logical-pixel canvas enlarged with nearest-neighbor blocks. Every feature must look intentionally designed at 74x100. Use no more than 32 opaque colors in muted earth tones. Crisp square steps, flat color clusters, no smooth illustration, no dithering or grain, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients.
Most important correction: the head and face must dominate. Extend the face lower, shorten the visible neck by about 70 percent. The beard/chin should end around logical row 87, only 4 to 5 rows of neck beneath it, and just 6 rows of collar at the bottom. No broad shoulders, no long diagonal neck column, no chest. Hair/hat stays completely intact. Recompose the head WITHIN the canvas; do not merely crop the current artwork.
Critical alpha safety: create genuine EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN equivalent to 3 logical pixels on both sides and above every hair, ear and hat tip. All hair and ears need complete natural contour inside those margins. No opaque or semitransparent fleck may touch any canvas edge. This margin must be part of the drawing itself, not an edge-cropped head hidden by later padding. At bottom also leave 2 logical transparent pixels below the narrow collar.
Eyes and expression: replace bright sclera with tiny dark warm-gray half-lidded eyes, predominantly dark. Remove the inner-brow upturn and the pleading inverted-V worried brows. Resting mouth is firmly closed, almost level, subtle concentration without smiling or grief. Keep a substantial stepped nose and broad connected cheekbone planes. Show age by two or three broad value planes, never an added web of wrinkle marks.
Background genuinely transparent. Single face only. No text, no props, no hands, no scenery, no border.
Identity invariants: Reha, a returned adult captive's father, male in his FIFTIES, NOT elderly or frail. Preserve swept-back silver-gray wavy hair, off-center part and complete ear/back hair contour; compact silver beard and mustache; brown collarless worn coat and moss-green tunic, only narrow collar visible. There is no hat on his head. The current image is too mournful: distinctly level both inner brows and flatten their outer slope, retain quiet reflective attention toward a doorway and a restrained closed resting mouth. Do not add a smile or completed-reconciliation mood. Simplify the silver hairstyle into only 4 or 5 broad wavy locks with ONE muted highlight plane each, fewer silver shades and no thin nested stripes. Beard should be large connected silver/gray planes with no bristly noise. Make the neck dramatically shorter, preserve the full silver hair and all right-side wisps at least 3 logical pixels away from the edge. Keep his leaner face distinct from the capped broad Buran.
